result.summary: Several visual and content issues: a broken/missing restaurant image, a truncated restaurant name, a clipped category chip, and a bottom promo card cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: The first card in Popular right now (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) shows a broken-image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Load a valid image for this restaurant or show a designed fallback so the card matches the rest of the list.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in Fastest near you (Trattoria Piccol…) is cut off on the right, so the name and part of the image are truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add enough horizontal padding or peek/scroll affordance so names and images aren’t clipped at the screen edge.

issues.description: The category chips row is cut off on the right (Healthy is clipped, next chip barely visible), with no clear indication of more categories.
issues.suggestion: Leave a visible peek of the next chip or add a fade/scroll hint so users know the row is scrollable.

issues.description: The pizza promo card at the bottom is partially hidden behind the tab bar, so the offer and restaurant details are incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the tab bar height so cards can fully scroll into view.

issues.description: Restaurant name “Trattoria Piccol” appears truncated without an ellipsis or wrap, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Show an ellipsis on overflow or allow two lines so the full restaurant name is identifiable.
